title: Onion acoustic recording metadata
description: Per-recording metadata for dataset-acoustic. One JSON file per recording. Fields mirror the project-wide contract; unknown values must be empty strings or null, never guessed.

onion_id.description: Groups recordings from the same physical onion; dataset splits are made at onion level, never at recording level.

audio_path.description: Repository-relative path of the audio file this metadata describes.

device.description: Recording device identifier, e.g. 'Samsung Galaxy A54' or 'ATR2500 USB mic'. Never leave 'unknown' for newly collected data.

variety.description: Onion cultivar if known; empty string otherwise. Cultivar-aware validation is required by Landahl et al. 2022.

external_label.description: Visible-condition label (e.g. sound, damaged, rotten, sprouted, undersized). Empty if not assessed.

internal_label.description: Internal-condition ground truth (e.g. firm, early_rot, hollow, rotten). MUST come from ground_truth_method below — never inferred from filenames or acoustics.

split.description: Assigned by the split tool at onion_id granularity; never hand-edited per recording.

capture_metadata.description: Phone-only capture provenance; required for phone_chirp / phone_tap recordings.
